findings.title: No rate limit on the free public /validate endpoint
findings.description: The Cloudflare Pages Function validated any number of addresses per client. Each uncached check fans out to up to 8 DNS-over-HTTPS subrequests.
findings.impact: One client could burn the Pages Functions request quota (taking the free endpoint down for everyone), and use the endpoint as a free bulk validator or DoH amplifier.
findings.remediation: Fixed-window limit of 100 requests per minute per IP, keyed by CF-Connecting-IP (IPv6 /64) and checked before DNS work. It counts in memory per isolate plus in a counter shared across the data center via the Cache API, and fails open to the in-memory count. Responds 429 with Retry-After and RateLimit-* headers; memory is bounded.
findings.human_action: Optional: add a Cloudflare WAF rate-limiting rule on /validate for an exact global cap (the shared counter is per data center and not atomic).

findings.title: Static site sent no anti-framing, HSTS or Permissions-Policy headers
findings.description: checkemail.dev could be embedded in a frame on any site; no HSTS or Permissions-Policy.
findings.impact: Clickjacking of the demo page; weaker transport guarantees.
findings.remediation: website/_headers adds HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP frame-ancestors/object-src/base-uri/form-action, Permissions-Policy, nosniff.
findings.test: Verified with wrangler pages dev (curl of /, /og.png, /nope)

findings.title: Release workflow used mutable action tags, Bun 'latest' and an interpolated secret
findings.description: The workflow that pushes to main and publishes to npm and Docker Hub ran actions by tag and the newest Bun, and expanded NPM_TOKEN inside the shell script.
findings.impact: A compromised or retagged action or Bun release would run with contents:write and id-token:write and could publish a malicious package.
findings.remediation: All actions pinned to commit SHAs, Bun pinned via packageManager, NPM_TOKEN passed through env.
findings.test: CI steps run locally with Bun 1.3.13

findings.title: Docker image ran the API as root
findings.description: No USER directive; the runtime stage also carried node_modules (TypeScript) it never used.
findings.impact: Any future RCE in the server or Bun would run as root inside the container.
findings.remediation: USER bun; runtime no longer copies node_modules (206 MB -> 174 MB); Dockerfile.dockerignore now applied.

findings.title: Transient DNS failures cached as 'domain does not exist' for an hour
findings.description: DoH timeouts/SERVFAIL surface as false / [] (not exceptions) and were cached for the full 1 h TTL.
findings.impact: After one network blip, a real domain was reported INVALID_DOMAIN or NO_MX_RECORDS (score 0) for an hour on that process or isolate.
findings.remediation: Negative answers cached for 60 s (new optional negativeTtlMs argument), positive answers still 1 h.

findings.title: Concurrent lookups of the same name were not shared
findings.description: checkMx and provider detection both query MX for the same domain at once; on a cold cache both went to the network.
findings.impact: Up to 2x DoH requests and slower cold checks.
findings.remediation: In-flight promises are shared per cache key.

findings.title: Releases were published without tests, CI, or a sanity check on the downloaded list
findings.description: No test suite or PR CI existed; the scheduled job committed and published whatever upstream returned.
findings.impact: A broken build or an empty/garbled disposable list would ship to npm, Docker Hub and the site.
findings.remediation: Test suite added; CI on every PR; publish runs typecheck + tests before committing and rejects lists under 5,000 lines or with unexpected characters.

findings.title: Unknown URLs returned the homepage with HTTP 200 (soft 404)
findings.description: With no 404.html, Cloudflare Pages serves index.html for every path.
findings.impact: Any typo or junk link becomes an indexable duplicate of the homepage.

findings.title: Title (73 chars) and meta description (188 chars) truncated in results
findings.remediation: Title 58 chars, description 162 chars; sitemap lastmod updated.

findings.title: Render-blocking third-party CSS and a 145 KB icon font slowed first paint
findings.description: Three cross-origin stylesheets blocked rendering; the Phosphor icon font (all ~1,500 icons) was downloaded for 21 icons.
findings.impact: Slower FCP/LCP (Core Web Vitals) on mobile.
findings.remediation: 21 icons inlined as CSS masks (3.4 KB gzipped); fonts load via preload/onload. FCP 716->284 ms, LCP 1064->672 ms, 335->184 KB, 0 render-blocking requests.
findings.test: Playwright before/after: icon boxes, pixel diff, throttled timings

findings.title: No AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
findings.description: Agents had no record of commands, conventions or security rules (rate limiting, privacy, browser-engine port).
findings.impact: Future changes could silently drop the rate limit or break the src/ <-> website parity.
findings.remediation: AGENTS.md as source of truth; CLAUDE.md imports it.

findings.title: No .env.example; README had no development/test instructions or API limits
findings.description: PORT undocumented outside the site; README claimed 'No rate limits' without scoping it to self-hosting.
findings.impact: Confusing for contributors and API users.
findings.remediation: .env.example, README Development section, hosted API limit documented in README, llms.txt, llms-full.txt and the site.
